messages:
incident-bot: P0 ALERT — spike in 5xx and timeouts for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Error rate ~22% over last 3m. Paging dave_oncall. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-5xx>

dave_oncall: ack, I'm on it. hitting alert dashboard now. assigning eng-runtime and SRE. tagging oncall-eng-runtime @bob_runtime

alice_sre: I'm online. can we get a quick blast-radius and customer impact? metrics look like gateway 502/504 + backend 5xx

bob_runtime: joining. seeing repeated segfaults from model-runner on inference nodes in shard us-east-1a. logs show OOM followed by SIGSEGV in attention kernel. grabbing pids.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-05-18T21:04:05Z started: rollout/model-runner@v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 (canary)

hector_infra: noticing increased evictions on the node pool. autoscaler trying to add nodes but some pods are crashlooping.

eva_support: two enterprise customers reported failures in prod (chat timeout + 502). Support ticket IDs: SUP-9421, SUP-9423. putting short update to customers once we have mitigation.

bob_runtime: tail from model-runner: ```
[2026-05-18T21:06:12Z] worker[1123]: allocation failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-05-18T21:06:12Z] worker[1123]: loading block 23/48
[2026-05-18T21:06:12Z] worker[1123]: segfault at 0x7f64fa3b
[2026-05-18T21:06:12Z] system: coredump written /var/crash/model-runner.1123.core
```

alice_sre: ok OOM -> segfault cascade. we should reduce concurrency/batching and failover traffic off the affected pool.

dave_oncall: bob, can you gate a quick mitigation: reduce model-runner concurrency to 1 and disable large-batch paths? then route traffic to us-east-1b + fallback quantized model.

bob_runtime: applying temporary runtime args to deployment: `--max-concurrency=1 --disable-batched-attention --prefetch=0` on the shard, and creating route override to prefer model-variant=redwood-small-quant in us-east-1b. doing patch now.

hector_infra: creating LB diversion policy: redirect 80% of `/v1/generate` to us-east-1b; 20% remains for telemetry. pushed.

frank_csm: updating affected customers that we are mitigating; will post ETA once stable. please call out reduced throughput and potential higher latency while we route.

bob_runtime: patch applied. restarting model-runner pods on affected nodes one-by-one. first restart shows reduced memory footprint, no immediate segfault. monitoring logs.

bob_runtime: logs after patch: ```
[2026-05-18T21:12:40Z] worker[2045]: init with --max-concurrency=1
[2026-05-18T21:12:41Z] worker[2045]: quantized path active: redwood-small-quant
[2026-05-18T21:12:42Z] worker[2045]: running, mem use stabilized at 19GB
```

alice_sre: gateway 5xx rate dropping from 22% -> 7% in the last 2m. good signal. keep the diversion for 15 mins and observe.

carol_ml: fyi, the failing path looks like large-sequence attention kernel. model quantization reduces memory but may change output characteristics slightly. we should run a quick smoke eval against critical prompt set.

eva_support: I've posted a short note to customers: "We've detected elevated errors for some inference requests in us-east-1. We've routed traffic to healthy capacity and applied temporary mitigations. We'll update in 30 minutes." SUP tickets updated.

alice_sre: can someone attach the core dump and a stack trace to the incident? we need it for postmortem and to determine whether it's a kernel bug or memory thrash.

bob_runtime: collected coredump path /var/crash/model-runner.1123.core and `gdb` backtrace attached to the incident ticket. opening INC-2026-234 in tracker with artifacts.

hector_infra: autoscaler had an issue where crashlooping pods prevented node join. I've increased node-creation timeout and drained two bad nodes. new nodes joining cleanly now.

dave_oncall: summary for handoff: root cause under investigation but immediate mitigation applied: reduced concurrency/batching, routed to quantized fallback in us-east-1b, drained bad nodes, restarts done. customer impact: SUP-9421/9423; error rate peaked ~22% and now ~3-5%.

frank_csm: customers acknowledge the update and appreciate the quick mitigation. they're fine with temporary degraded latency.

carol_ml: next step request from ML: reproduce locally with same sequence length + kernel flags, run memprof, and test small patch that avoids the problematic attention kernel. I'll pair with bob_runtime.

bob_runtime: agreed. creating a short-lived repro job: `kubectl run repro-infer --image=runner:debug --env SEQ=8192 --model redwood-large` and will attach heap profiles. kicking it off.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused: model-runner@v3.2.2 paused due to elevated error rate on canary hosts.

alice_sre: ok leaving diversion in place. I'll keep an eye for regressions. if error rate climbs above 10% again we escalate to full incident call. dave, handoff to next oncall at 22:00 UTC: note artifacts and mitigation in INC-2026-234.

dave_oncall: handoff ack. I'll post a concise handoff message in the incident channel and update the runbook with steps taken. thanks everyone.

bob_runtime: attaching immediate todo: 1) analyze coredump and trace mem allocator, 2) run ML repro with kernel flags, 3) consider guardrail to refuse >4096 tokens for now, 4) follow up on canary rollout after root cause. assigning owners in ticket.

hector_infra: follow-up infra item: add alert to detect crashloop spike vs pure load spike to avoid autoscaler thrash. filing INFRA-370.

alice_sre: final note for status page: "Partial mitigation in place — traffic routed to healthy capacity. Investigating root cause of runtime crashes. Potentially affected customers have been contacted. Next update in 30 minutes or on resolution." Please review before posting.

eva_support: reviewed, good to post. publishing now.

dave_oncall: closing this thread for now — monitoring period started. handoff documented. last_state: diversion active, concurrency limits enforced, coredump collected, ticket INC-2026-234 opened. will reopen if error rate worsens.
